fallbackFaqItems.question: Are the products genuine?
fallbackFaqItems.answer: Yes. Products sold are original Herbalife Nutrition products. This site belongs to an independent distributor; not the official Herbalife site.

fallbackFaqItems.question: How long does shipping take?
fallbackFaqItems.answer: After payment confirmation, orders usually ship within 1–3 business days. We share the tracking code in your notification.

fallbackFaqItems.question: How can I pay?
fallbackFaqItems.answer: Card payments use the secure PayTR infrastructure. There is no cash on delivery. Apply coupon codes at checkout if you have one.

fallbackFaqItems.question: Do I have a right of withdrawal?
fallbackFaqItems.answer: Distance sales include a 14-day withdrawal right. See Returns & cancellation; apply with your order number.

fallbackFaqItems.question: What is nutrition tracking?
fallbackFaqItems.answer: Log water, meals, and measurements in your account; your coach can approve and support you.

fallbackFaqItems.question: Which bundle should I choose?
fallbackFaqItems.answer: We offer gift bundles for your goal. Product advice is available on WhatsApp — typical reply under one hour.
